title: Allgemeinverfügung anlässlich des zweiten nationalen Veteranentages – Einschränkungen im Berliner Regierungsviertel

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order with security measures and road closures in the government district in Mitte for the second national Veterans Day on 21 June 2026, from 8 to 20 hours. Parking and public assemblies are prohibited in the marked areas.
